```{r,echo=FALSE}
a = sample(2:9,1)*sample(c(-1,1),1)

fac1 = paste0("x+",-a,collapse="")
fac1 = gsub("+-","-",fac1,fixed=T)

```

Question
========

Let function $f$ be a polynomial. If $`r fac1`$ is a factor of the polynomial, then what root is known? In other words, for what value of $x$ do we know $f(x)=0$?


Solution
========

See the [zero product property](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zero-product_property).

A polynomial equals zero whenever one of its factors equals zero.

The root is `r a`. In other words, we know $f(`r a`)=0$.
